review_kind: independent read-only source and active inventory review

actual_data_validity.note: No evidence of direct old metadata reuse in the active default command path; this review does not grant coordinate, target or time authority.

passed_checks: runtime meta/report/checkpoint outputs are inside new repository on C:
active artifact helper rejects direct archive and external paths
legacy metadata_root inventory/config fields are rejected
old OfflineTargets cache bridge is absent
source_policy contains prior_metadata_inputs=[] and detects endian from source payload
SensorDataset and target readers retain G0 checks
environment writer preserves existing lock identity when executable and packages are unchanged

findings.summary: Nested gate artifact paths bypass archive/external path isolation.
findings.evidence: In-memory mock gate with matching digest and artifact archive/synthetic_not_opened.json was accepted. No archive file was opened by the probe.
findings.impact: A current-generation gate could cite forbidden archived research evidence even though direct CLI paths are rejected. Current G0 remains false.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply active_artifact_path to research artifact entries before hashing and validate their generation where applicable.
findings.suggested_test: Reject a current-generation gate whose nested artifact points to archive or external old metadata.

findings.summary: Window manifest generation is not checked against expected_generation.
findings.evidence: In-memory probe with current inventory/normalizer and different-generation JsonlSequence was accepted; source reads and hashes were mocked.
findings.impact: After G0 approval an otherwise valid current reader could consume stale windows supplied from another in-repository generation.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate manifest generation, source inventory/split/sampling hashes, and rows before exposing the dataset.
findings.suggested_test: Reject copied older windows with current inventory/normalizer before __getitem__ or any model invocation.

findings.summary: Some orchestration paths do not pass the expected runtime generation to their input validators.
findings.evidence: build-qa constructs TargetArrayStore(target_root) without expected_generation and stamps runtime generation into output provenance; prepare_data invokes assert_fresh_inventory without expected_generation.
findings.impact: Copied valid prior artifacts outside archive can be relabeled as the current generation. No actual relabeling was observed.
findings.suggested_fix: Thread expected_generation through inventory, target, manifest and QA validation; check nested evidence paths in direct/reference target provenance as well.
findings.suggested_test: Wrong-generation inventory/targets/manifest inside repository must fail prepare and build-qa.

findings.summary: Finalizer records a failed source integrity check but continues to finalize locks/report.
findings.evidence: After writing source_integrity_final.json the flow continues without rejecting any matches_new_audit=False entry.
findings.impact: If source changes, final summary could still present finalized artifacts despite a failed source snapshot check. Active inventory records unchanged source; no mismatch observed.
findings.suggested_fix: Stop finalization on any source hash mismatch and preserve failed evidence only.
findings.suggested_test: Mock one source hash mismatch and assert no new accepted runtime lock/registry is produced.

limitations: GPU profiles and pilot were running independently and were not verified here.
Native resource or scientific completion is not inferred from code review.
Findings describe guard gaps, not proof that current rebuilt outputs reused archived data.
